description: FFmpeg 8.x shared libraries (pinned, see below) - library-only dependency for vdf, adds nothing to PATH
notes: Pinned to the 8.x series on purpose. This is not a general-purpose ffmpeg - install main/ffmpeg or main/ffmpeg-shared for that. It exists so vdf can keep using its fast native FFmpeg binding: VDF.Core pins FFmpeg.AutoGen 8.1.0, which P/Invokes avcodec-62.dll, avutil-60.dll and avformat-62.dll by name, and main/ffmpeg-shared has moved on to 9.x (avcodec-63, avutil-61, avformat-63).

Deliberately no env_add_path, no env_set and no shims, so it cannot collide with main/ffmpeg-shared over the ffmpeg.exe shim or the FFMPEG_DIR variable. Both can be installed side by side; only apps that reach into ...\apps\ffmpeg8-shared\current\bin themselves will see this copy.

checkver only ever matches an 8.x asset, so Excavator tracks 8.x point releases and never jumps to 9.x. It reads one page of 100 releases; upstream interleaves nightly git builds with numbered ones, so once 8.x scrolls off that page checkver simply stops matching and the version stays put - it can never bump to the wrong major.
Retire this manifest once upstream VDF bumps its FFmpeg.AutoGen reference to a 9.x binding: vdf's pre_install already prefers this package but falls back to main/ffmpeg-shared.
